intro: Arkansas Legislative Audit examines every county and publishes what it finds. This page quotes what the auditors reported about Hempstead County, from its latest report — no verdict added in either direction. What the auditors said is the record; what to make of it is yours.
regulatory_basis_note: Read this before reading any Arkansas audit: county and city reports carry a technical 'adverse opinion' on GAAP grounds because Arkansas law has them keep books on a simpler 'regulatory basis.' That phrase appears in every such audit in the state and signals the accounting format — not wrongdoing. A report is 'clean' or not in its findings, deficiencies, and noncompliance sections, which is what this page quotes.

verdicts.quote: During our evaluation, nothing came to our attention that would warrant disclosure in this report.
verdicts.detail: A limited review (a “financial and compliance report”), not a full audit: the financial statements in it are unaudited.

limits: From the 2024 report, dated July 15, 2025. Read by machine from the report’s text; the quotes are the auditors’ words. Older reports, and the separate federal (single) audits, aren’t on this page yet.
Arkansas alternates between full audits and limited “financial and compliance” reviews; each line says which this is.

cities.name: Blevins
cities.quote: Noncompliance with state law and accepted accounting practices was noted in the office of Mayor. Mayor The City was in noncompliance with Ark. Code Ann. §§ 14-58-202, -203 as noted below: • Budgets could not be provided for the General Fund and Street Fund for 2024.

cities.name: Fulton
cities.quote: Noncompliance with state law and accepted accounting practices was noted in the offices of Mayor and Recorder/Treasurer. Mayor Street Fund expenditures for 2024 exceeded budgeted appropriations by $5,513 (79%) in noncompliance with Ark. Code Ann. § 14-58- 203.

cities.name: Hope
cities.quote: The results of our tests disclosed no instances of noncompliance or other matters that are required to be reported under Government Auditing Standards.

cities.name: Oakhaven
cities.quote: Noncompliance with state law and accepted accounting practices was noted in the offices of the Mayor and the Recorder/Treasurer. Mayor The Town was in noncompliance with Ark.
